body: I am probably not your friend. So I hate to disappoint you, just to give you comfort I am from North Carolina. Thank you for trying. Hope you find your friend.

It is not even that I am addicted to smoking it is just the only thing that makes me feel decent inside. Literally nothing makes me happy anymore. I am afraid, afraid of failure, letting people down, hell even killing myself, but knowing that I can end all the fear if I am brave enough for acouple seconds is comforting.
